name: Camcorder Tape
blurb: Home-video camcorder look: the B-roll plays full-frame through a viewfinder HUD (blinking REC dot, running tape counter, battery, focus brackets), with VHS tracking wobble, chroma bleed and scanlines; captions in a chunky VCR font; on the turn the tape fast-forwards (>> with rolling bars) into the colour reveal; the title is the tape label on screen. No dates anywhere, only the tape counter.
